text:
alex: Heads up — rolling a new staging VPC egress encryption policy at 16:00 UTC. This forces stricter TLS/mTLS for outbound to KMS and audit endpoints. Could affect GPU warm-pool/node joins. cc @maya-ops @sam

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy by alex for staging/vpc-egress-encryption at 2026-03-21T16:00:00Z

maya-ops: Is this the change that forces client certs to the NATGW proxy? Does it open new ports or change keepalive behavior?

alex: No new ports. It enforces mTLS to our egress-proxy and adds L7 inspection for audit capture. Keepalives are unchanged but handshake frequency increases.

sam: Quick note — when we last tightened egress to L7 we saw STS/key fetch 403s from nodes that used IRSA-like mappings. If the proxy strips or delays the OIDC assertion, KMS decrypts fail and node bootstrap stalls. Recommend canary first.

jin: Also saw conntrack pressure on NATGW when L7 inspection enabled; GPU nodes joining create lots of short flows -> conntrack explosion -> ~60-120s join stalls. Can we do AZ-scoped canary?

alex: Plan: 15:50 create canary pool in eu-west-1a (2 nodes), 16:00 apply policy to staging, monitor join-rate, kms decrypt errors and NATGW conntrack. Rollback policy at 16:20 if join failures >5% or KMS decrypt errors spike.

maya-ops: FYI enabling mTLS increases audit log volume — rough staging delta +400USD/month (prod will be larger). @lisa please confirm if staging cost is OK.

lisa: Finance ok for staging test. Prod retention/cost needs approval from platform finance.

sam: Pulled a sample from last run — error we saw: 
```
2026-02-10T09:12:41Z kubelet[info] "GET /v1/decrypt" 403 AccessDenied "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity" missing
```
Looks like the proxy was dropping the webidentity token header intermittently.

alex: Mitigations pre-approved: 1) add temporary egress exception for kms.{staging}.internal 2) enable NATGW autoscale policy (temporarily lower trigger) 3) if we see role-related 403s, fallback to exception and investigate token passthrough.

jin: I can bump NATGW desired capacity and lower autoscale threshold for the canary window. Note: bumping will add cost but avoids restarts. Flow logs will be sampled at 10% to watch conntrack behavior.

ops-note: If we see >10% join failures, automated rollback will trigger.

sam: I will run a quick script to curl the KMS endpoint through the egress proxy from a joiner pod: `kubectl run keycheck --image=alpine --restart=Never --rm -it -- /bin/sh -c "apk add curl; curl -v https://kms.staging.internal/v1/keys/health"` and check headers.

alex: Good. Action items: jin -> adjust NATGW scaling + sampling, sam -> run token passthrough checks, maya-ops -> create canary + watch, lisa -> finance aware. I'll coordinate rollout and watch dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/staging/egress/join-rate

maya-ops: Canary created (eu-west-1a) at 15:52. Starting metric baseline capture.

[15:59] deploy-bot: Policy apply queued by alex for staging at 16:00

sam: First quick check — token passthrough looks OK from pod but backend returned 403 in one attempt, headers included: `Authorization: Bearer <redacted>` and `X-Forwarded-Client-Cert: present`

jin: NATGW conntrack at 15:58: before policy 23k entries, after policy +1min 78k entries (sampling). I'll keep scaling + monitor.

alex: If join delays exceed 30s for >5% nodes, we rollback. Keep comms here. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
